description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakePreferences component, specifically testing functions related to sanitizing, displaying, loading, and saving trigger words in the VoiceWakePreferences class.

classes.name: VoiceWakePreferencesTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for the VoiceWakePreferences functionalities, ensuring proper sanitization, display, and persistence of trigger words.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWordsTrimsAndDropsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that sanitizeTriggerWords trims whitespace and drops empty strings.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWordsFallsBackToDefaultsWhenEmpty
methods.description: Tests that sanitizeTriggerWords returns default trigger words when input is empty.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWordsLimitsWordLength
methods.description: Ensures that sanitizeTriggerWords enforces maximum word length.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWordsLimitsWordCount
methods.description: Checks that sanitizeTriggerWords limits the number of trigger words to maxWords.

methods.name: displayStringUsesSanitizedWords
methods.description: Verifies that displayString correctly joins sanitized words into a displayable string.

methods.name: loadAndSaveTriggerWordsRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests the round-trip loading and saving of trigger words using UserDefaults.
